channel.title: GetMyYes Health Insurance Appeal Guides
channel.description: Plain-English health insurance appeal guides and free letter templates.

item.title: "Not Medically Necessary" Denial? How to Appeal (+ Free Template)
item.description: Insurance denied your claim as 'not medically necessary'? Learn how to request the criteria and clinical rationale, organize relevant evidence, and use a free appeal template.

item.title: Drug Not Covered / Formulary Exclusion? How to Appeal (+ Free Template)
item.description: Medication not on your insurance formulary? How to request a formulary exception with your prescriber, appeal a denial, and a free exception letter template.

item.title: Free Health Insurance Appeal Letter Template (Copy & Paste, 2026)
item.description: Free appeal letter template for health insurance denials — copy, paste, and fill in. Includes line-by-line instructions, an urgent/expedited version, and what to attach.

item.title: How to Appeal a Health Insurance Denial (2026 Step-by-Step Guide)
item.description: Denied by your health insurance? Step-by-step guide to internal appeals and external review: applicable deadlines, supporting documents, and a free appeal letter template.

item.title: Prior Authorization Denied? How to Appeal (+ Free Template)
item.description: Prior authorization denied by your insurance? How to appeal a prior auth denial, when to demand a 72-hour expedited review, and a free appeal letter template.

item.title: Step Therapy Denial? How to Get an Exception (+ Free Template)
item.description: Denied because of step therapy or 'fail first' rules? Your treatment history may already qualify you for an exception. How to appeal, plus a free step-therapy exception letter template.

item.title: “Experimental or Investigational” Denial? How to Appeal
item.description: How to appeal an experimental or investigational treatment denial, obtain the insurer's clinical rationale, organize medical evidence, and request external review.

item.title: External Review of a Health Insurance Denial: Steps & Deadlines
item.description: How independent external review works after a health insurance denial: eligibility, the four-month filing window, 45-day and 72-hour timelines, and a free request template.

item.title: Out-of-Network Claim Denied? How to Appeal
item.description: How to appeal an out-of-network health insurance denial, check No Surprises Act protections, document a network-directory error, and use a free letter template.
